# InCabin Europe 2026


**22–24 September 2026 | Barcelona, Spain**


Neonode is heading to[InCabin Europe 2026](https://incabin.com/europe/) , where the automotive interior intelligence community comes together to explore the technologies shaping safer, smarter and more intuitive vehicle experiences.


Join us in Barcelona to discover how Neonode’s latest advances in driver and occupant monitoring are helping vehicles build a deeper understanding of the people inside them.


## Understanding Driver Intentions Through Hand-Tracking


Driver monitoring has traditionally focused heavily on where the driver is looking. But understanding visual attention is only part of understanding what a driver is doing, and what they intend to do next.


On September 23, Agnes Jernström, Senior Software Engineer at Neonode, will go on stage to present how combining eye-tracking with hand-tracking can give Driver Monitoring Systems a richer understanding of driver and passenger behavior.


By analysing where hands are positioned, how they move and how occupants interact with objects and vehicle controls, hand-tracking can add valuable context to gaze information. A driver looking away from the road while interacting with the infotainment system, for example, represents a different situation from a driver repeatedly focusing on an object held in their hand.


This additional context can help vehicles distinguish between different types of distraction, support more appropriate warning strategies and enable new in-cabin experiences as assisted driving and AI-powered vehicle interfaces continue to evolve.


Agnes will cover:


- Why hand-tracking is important for understanding driver and passenger behaviour
- How combining hand and eye information can improve safety and convenience
- In-cabin features that can be enabled through hand-action analysis
- How Neonode’s Driver and In-Cabin Monitoring software provides the information needed to enable these applications
